<thought>To propose a one‑step retrosynthesis we need a template that, in the forward direction, converts a ketone (or ester) and an alkyne into the target cyclic product via a cycloaddition, breaking a C‑O bond and forming a C‑C bond. The appropriate functional‑group changes are: the forward reaction breaks a ketone (or ester) and forms a C‑C triple bond. I will search the template catalog for such a transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
